Dear {{2.`webhook data`.`full name`}},

Your leave request has been reviewed by the system and was **automatically rejected** due to a policy violation.

Our records show that you requested more than 4 days of leave but did not upload the required supporting document. As per the company's leave policy, a valid supporting document is mandatory for all leave requests exceeding 4 days.

Please submit a new leave request with the required supporting document attached.

If you believe this rejection was made in error, please contact the HR department.

Thank you for your understanding.

Regards,
HR Team
